## Source: amazon-inspector (4cde2a585dd043f57af2c96aa193590190a335a411f0b2fa2f52d0ee2ec17bb9)
Package sedgehaul version 0.1.0 was scanned across 11 files. No install-time or import-time network activity, credential or filesystem access to installer-secret paths, lifecycle shell execution, remote fetch-and-execute, silent relay, or persistence mechanism was observed in the shipped contents.

## Source: kam193 (1eccea61ba89da6dd32ddad1e54e70f52c5a2b2c9aeeced8a80e068ef63dccd4)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
